title: Heigan the Unclean: The Safety Dance
summary: Follow the safe floor wedges while managing fever and mana burn.
overview: Follow the safe floor wedges while managing fever and mana burn.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: During combat, cure Decrepit Fever with disease cures.
Pure casters should leave the purple mana-burn radius and use the refuge when warned.
During the dance, follow the safe wedge as it travels across the floor and back. Warnings shorten on later dances.
Combat lasts 90 seconds and each dance lasts 45 seconds.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 6.
Ground markers require compatible telegraph support; geometry and client display have not been live-verified.
